concepts.title: Continuum
concepts.short: A bounded ongoing system whose identity is carried through relations and transformations.
concepts.learning_goal: Understand continuum as continuity under change.
concepts.try_it: Change a parameter and watch how continuum moves in graph, simulation and evidence views.
concepts.nonclaim: This module teaches OC vocabulary; it is not an independent proof of the theory.

concepts.title: Boundary
concepts.short: The rule that separates what belongs to a continuum from its environment and interfaces.
concepts.learning_goal: Understand boundary as membership and interface.
concepts.try_it: Change a parameter and watch how boundary moves in graph, simulation and evidence views.
concepts.nonclaim: This module teaches OC vocabulary; it is not an independent proof of the theory.

concepts.title: Operator
concepts.short: A transformation acting on a continuum, changing state while preserving or breaking structure.
concepts.learning_goal: Understand operator as action over state.
concepts.try_it: Change a parameter and watch how operator moves in graph, simulation and evidence views.
concepts.nonclaim: This module teaches OC vocabulary; it is not an independent proof of the theory.

concepts.title: Coherence
concepts.short: The degree to which relations, evidence and operations still hold together.
concepts.learning_goal: Understand coherence as stability of relations.
concepts.try_it: Change a parameter and watch how coherence moves in graph, simulation and evidence views.
concepts.nonclaim: This module teaches OC vocabulary; it is not an independent proof of the theory.

concepts.title: Collapse
concepts.short: A transition where coherence debt overwhelms correction and the prior description fails.
concepts.learning_goal: Understand collapse as failure of continuity.
concepts.try_it: Change a parameter and watch how collapse moves in graph, simulation and evidence views.
concepts.nonclaim: This module teaches OC vocabulary; it is not an independent proof of the theory.

concepts.title: Emergence
concepts.short: A pattern that becomes visible only through relations across levels or boundaries.
concepts.learning_goal: Understand emergence as new visible structure.
concepts.try_it: Change a parameter and watch how emergence moves in graph, simulation and evidence views.
concepts.nonclaim: This module teaches OC vocabulary; it is not an independent proof of the theory.

concepts.title: Projection
concepts.short: A controlled view of a continuum into a domain, graph, simulation or claim surface.
concepts.try_it: Change a parameter and watch how projection moves in graph, simulation and evidence views.
concepts.nonclaim: This module teaches OC vocabulary; it is not an independent proof of the theory.

concepts.title: Evidence / Nonclaim
concepts.short: The rule that separates what the demo shows from what the science does not claim.
concepts.learning_goal: Understand evidence / nonclaim as trust boundary.
concepts.try_it: Change a parameter and watch how evidence / nonclaim moves in graph, simulation and evidence views.
concepts.nonclaim: This module teaches OC vocabulary; it is not an independent proof of the theory.

simulations.purpose: Show how pressure, coherence and correction interact during a bounded transition.
